products.name: JAIS (G42 / Inception)
products.note: Arabic-centric LLM; UAE sovereign AI; cultural alignment; Middle East data governance

profile_text.body:
G42 is a technology group founded in Abu Dhabi that describes itself as inventing artificial intelligence "for a better everyday." The company says it operates across more than 30 countries and organizes its work around what it calls the Intelligence Grid, a unified infrastructure combining compute, cloud, data centers, connectivity, and domain-specific AI solutions aimed at sectors including healthcare, energy, governance, and security. It describes the Intelligence Grid as a "super-utility" intended to deliver AI capability at national scale, and says its group comprises ten companies working toward that shared mission.

On the product side, G42 has developed JAIS, an Arabic-centric large language model positioned as a sovereign AI offering for the UAE, with an emphasis on cultural alignment and Middle East data governance. The company also describes a voice-driven generative interface designed to learn and adapt to individual users in real time, handling information queries through dialogue and personalized briefings, which it frames as part of an "AI-native web" direction. These efforts reflect G42's stated focus on building AI that can serve both people and specific regional contexts.
